title: CoreWeave
lead: CoreWeave reported a $60.7 billion revenue backlog in an April 2026 SEC filing [3] and expects to end 2026 with 1.85 GW of data center capacity [4]. Between April and October it raised debt through notes, convertible notes and a term loan [3, 5] and announced its first sites in Asia-Pacific and India [6, 9].

items.head: Enters India with AdaniConneX
items.text: CoreWeave plans a 240 MW AI cloud deployment at the AdaniConneX Taloja campus in Navi Mumbai, its first footprint in India [9].

items.head: Willow picks CoreWeave for training
items.text: Willow Care, maker of the Willow Voice dictation app, chose CoreWeave for model training [10].

items.head: CoreWeave Forge
items.text: CoreWeave launched Forge, a development environment connecting model training, inference, observability, evaluation and post-training [8].

items.head: Customer at Blockfusion, Niagara Falls
items.text: Blockfusion signed CoreWeave as a customer at its Niagara Falls, New York campus [7].

items.head: Q2: revenue and net loss both double
items.text: CoreWeave doubled both revenue and net loss in Q2 as debt reached $35 billion, and raised its year-end capacity expectation from 1.7 GW to 1.85 GW [4].

items.head: $2.6 billion delayed-draw loan
items.text: CoreWeave closed a $2.6 billion delayed draw term loan facility [5].

items.head: First Asia-Pacific sites, in Indonesia
items.text: CoreWeave announced three Indonesian facilities scheduled for 2028, its first data center presence in Asia-Pacific; DCD reports 360 MW of capacity [6].

items.head: $4.25 billion debt offering
items.text: CoreWeave raised $4.25 billion through $1.25 billion of senior unsecured notes and $3 billion of convertible notes, and reported a $60.7 billion revenue backlog [3].

method: Sourced facts only. Identity fields come from the Faraday companies row [1]; Theater and Sectors from the Airtable Briefing Library record [2]; every other sentence restates a crawled artifact's recorded summary [3–10]. No Faraday's Take, no forecast and no call-to-action appear in a Profile. Primary articles were not re-fetched. Status: draft, not signed off (Brand Bible §07).
